The organization I work for (UC Davis Center for Water-Energy Efficiency) has an open job posting for an analyst/data scientist. We primarily work on issues at the intersection of water and energy conservation in California. The work would involve a wide range of data processing, analysis, and application development to support ongoing projects.

Here is a link to the full description:
www.employment.ucdavis.edu/applicants/Central?quickFind=73770

Note one correction to the posted description; the first line under minimum qualifications should have included experience with R as an essential skill:
Knowledge of programming languages for data analysis - R, Python, or Julia

The application deadline is Friday, July 1.

About the Center
The Center for Water-Energy Efficiency (CWEE) is an interdisciplinary research group administered by the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering in the College of Engineering at UC Davis. CWEE is also one of several centers of excellence affiliated with the Energy Efficiency Center (EEC) and is co-located with the Transportation and Energy Research programs at the university’s, zero-net-energy, West Village development. The mission of the CWEE is to research, develop, and disseminate efficient technologies and system based policies for the integrated conservation of water and energy resources. CWEE brings together a range of disciplines, agencies and organizations across California to conduct, translate and disseminate science and policy based research to advance innovations in water efficiency and the water energy nexus within the State.

Please forward the job posting links to those in your networks who you think may be interested in this position. Feel free to contact me directly if you have any questions.
